Comment EBOOK and I'll send you the full Faceless AI Affiliate ebook. 🔒

One-time pays once. Monthly keeps paying. Same referral, same work, very different year.

A pay-once offer resets you every month. You start at zero and sell the same number of people again just to stay level.

Take four sign-ups. A year later, on a monthly offer, all four can still be paying. On a pay-once offer, that number is zero.

So the thing to watch is who stays. Monthly only adds up if people keep using the tool. Promote things people keep.

And the first real milestone is small: a few monthly referrals covering the tool you promote.
